sources.diaphragm: ASCE 7-22 Sec 12.10.1.1, Eqs 12.10-1 to 12.10-3: Fpx from the storey forces, at least 0.2 SDS Ie wpx and at most 0.4 SDS Ie wpx (SDS = 2.5 x a_h = 2.5 x 0.4 SDS); collectors with Omega0 in SDC C-F (Sec 12.10.2.1); +25 % on the connections of irregular buildings (Sec 12.3.3.4).
